verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate banking and cards SaaS with a public REST API, so an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions one. The llms.txt index, Markdown versions of doc pages, and the OAuth REST API are adjacent agent-friendly building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
